extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking to submit fiction or nonfiction (especially LGBTQ/erotica) to small presses
extracted.subtask_description: Notifies writers that Cleis Press is accepting fiction and nonfiction proposals and lists the topics/genres they want; directs authors to follow the publisher's submission guidelines and submit by email. Useful for authors preparing proposals to this specific indie press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance: LGBTQ+ nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cleis Press is explicitly accepting proposals in LGBTQ+ nonfiction. Authors should review the press's catalog (link provided) to assess fit and examples of previously published LGBTQ+ nonfiction titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance: Nonfiction on sex and sexuality
rubrics_metrics.description: Nonfiction on the topic of sex and sexuality (self-help, sexual guides, LGBTQ+ and/or women’s studies, feminism, dating and relationships, sexual health, memoir)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists specific subtopics (self-help, sexual guides, LGBTQ+/women's studies, feminism, dating and relationships, sexual health, memoir) as examples of welcomed nonfiction proposals; authors should tailor proposals to these topical areas where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance: Erotic fiction (erotica/romance)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cleis Press accepts erotic fiction and romance. Given the publisher's stated focus, submissions should align with erotic/romantic content and can encompass diverse sexual preferences and kinks (publisher also notes interest in BDSM).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher focus / topical fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Indie publisher focusing on LGBTQ, BDSM, romance, and erotic writing for all sexual preferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should ensure subject matter, tone, and audience match Cleis Press's stated focus before preparing a proposal. Familiarity with the press's existing catalog is recommended to determine fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission format: proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Cleis Press accepting fiction and nonfiction proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The announcement refers specifically to 'proposals' rather than (explicitly) unsolicited full manuscripts — prospective authors should prepare a proposal package per the publisher's guidance (see linked submission guidelines for what to include).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method: email only
rubrics_metrics.description: How to submit: By email only, specific instructions provided at their website
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must be emailed; follow the 'specific instructions provided at their website.' Do not use postal submissions or other channels unless the publisher's site says otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow publisher submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Be sure to follow detailed guidelines at Cleis Press Submission Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The post emphasizes following the detailed publisher guidelines linked on Cleis Press's site. These guidelines will contain required elements, formatting, and any other procedural or content requirements for proposals.
